We have data blocks for several quotes. Need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014) and determine which vendor offers fastest delivery. We have four vendors: Acme Computing Ltd, BrightPath Systems, Nimbus Tech Supply, Orbital IT Partners. We need to extract delivery lead times.

From Acme: "Delivery lead time: 14 business days from purchase order". BrightPath: "Delivery lead time: 21 calendar days from purchase order". Nimbus: "Delivery lead time 7 business days". Orbital: "lead_time: 10 business days".

Thus fastest is Nimbus Tech Supply with 7 business days. Need to output "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply". Ensure we mention vendor name exactly. The vendor name is "Nimbus Tech Supply". So final answer: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply".
